description: A separately installed addon that provides app-specific shortcut overlays for VS Code, OpenCode, Chrome, Claude Code, Slack, Teams, Discord, and Google Meet.
capabilities: Provides eight generated overlay decks and no user-facing button types; install @sirenodeck/addon-app-shortcuts separately.
Each deck displays shortcuts for its target app. Matching apps can make their overlay available or bring it forward when autoShow is enabled.
Overlay navigation is independent of your main deck and returns to the previous deck when dismissed or when its app trigger stops matching.
